item.title: Variscite and CELUS bring AI to SoM design
item.summary: Variscite has integrated its System on Module (SoM) portfolio into the CELUS Design Platform, using AI-assisted tools to help engineers move more quickly from an initial hardware concept toward a production-ready design. The collaboration combines Variscite’s NXP-based modules with the CELUS AI Design Assistant to automate parts of component selection and early-stage design.
